LogList.fileType: Log type. Valid values: `slowlog`: slow log download list; `runlog`: run log download list; `auditlog`: audit list
LogList.startTime: Start time, in the format "yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss"
LogList.endTime: End time, format "yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss". If not specified, logs within start time + 24 hours are returned by default; the maximum time span between start time and end time is 7 days.
